ἐπιτηδεύμασι διαφ θείρονται, ἀλλ' οὐχὶ ἡ φαύλη ε ννοια τάχα διαφθείρει, ἀλλ' αὐτὸ
ταύτης ἐπιτέλεσμα τῆς ἐννοίας.
pass_a_gloss: They-corrupted, and they-became-abominable in practices. Having-come, says the Lord, not-even one I-found of-goodness a-worker, but liable to-every deed out-of-place. If in the practices they-are-corrupted, but not the worthless thought perhaps corrupts, but itself of-this completion of-the thought.
pass_b_english: “They corrupted, and became abominable in practices” (Psalm 13:1).

Coming, says the Lord, I did not find even one worker of goodness, but liable to every out-of-place deed. If they are corrupted in the practices, then perhaps it is not the worthless thought that corrupts, but the very completion of this thought.

choices.term: οὐχὶ ἡ φαύλη ἔννοια τάχα διαφθείρει, ἀλλ’ αὐτὸ ταύτης ἐπιτέλεσμα
choices.english: perhaps it is not the worthless thought that corrupts, but the very completion of this thought
choices.why: Corruption is located in the completed practice, not the mere thought. Not ‘thoughts are already the sin’.
